summary: Allows adding multiple students to the system simultaneously by uploading a pre-filled Excel file.
steps: Locate and click on the 'excel upload' option.
Download the provided 'sample file' (sample excel template).
Fill in the student data into the downloaded sample Excel file, ensuring all basic details are correctly entered.
Upload the completed Excel file back into the system.
business_rules: The system requires the use of the provided sample Excel file for bulk uploads.
If required data is not filled in the Excel file, the student will not be added, and an error message will be displayed.
The same basic details as for individual student addition must be provided in the Excel file.
important_notes: Always use the official sample Excel file to ensure correct data formatting and successful upload.
Review error messages carefully if students are not added, as they indicate missing or incorrect data.
questions: How can I add multiple students to the system at once?
Where can I find the sample Excel file for bulk student upload?
What happens if I miss required fields in the bulk upload Excel sheet?
Can I use my own custom Excel format for uploading student data in bulk?
